full_judgment: 2. On an F.I.R. lodged by the opposite party on 7-11-80 alleging that the accused petitioners and some others cut and took away paddy from 11 .S. Plot Nos. 1109, 1110 and 1111 of R.S. Khatian No. 43 of Mouza Gheramara P.S. Mirsaria, the police after investigation submitted charge-sheet under section 143/447/397 of the Penal Code against the petitioners and 12 others, whereupon G.R. Case No. 704 of 1980 was started in the Court of Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Sadar, North, Chittagong. Earlier to the lodging of the F.I.R., Mulkutar Rahman, father of the accused-petitioners had filed Other Suit No. 28 of 1978 in the 3rd. Court of Munsif, Sadar, Chittagong against Bazlur Rahman, father of opposite party Badiul Alam and some others for permanent injunction restraining the defendant No. 2 of the Suit, who is Bazlur Rahman, father of the opposite-party complainant here from interfering with the plaintiff's possession in R.S Plot No. No. 1109 and 1110 and some other plots. In the suit the plaintiff had obtained an order of temporary injunction on 25-7-78 and it is alleged that the criminal proceeding was started during the continuance of injunction. The petitioners moved this Court for staying the criminal proceeding till disposal of the civil suit on the ground that the matter in question could be more appropriately dealt with in the civil suit which was started much earlier than the criminal proceeding and the decision in the civil suit will have a direct bearing in the criminal proceeding and further that the Criminal case was started with a view to harass the petitioners and obtained the rule.
